m: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes for jammy yolks, then cool in cold water and peel.
Croutons: tear the Turkish roll into bite-sized chunks, toss with a little oil and salt and bake at 200°C for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and crunchy.

Dressing: whisk the mayo with the grated garlic, half the parmesan (finely grated), the lemon juice, a few dashes of Worcestershire and plenty of black pepper. Loosen with a splash of water until it pours.
Halve the chicken breasts horizontally so they're an even thickness. Season and cook in a hot oiled pan for 4 to 5 minutes a side until golden and just cooked through. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
In the same pan, cook the bacon until crisp, then char the asparagus in the bacon fat for 2 to 3 minutes.
Toss the cos leaves with most of the dressing. Top with the chicken, asparagus, bacon, croutons and halved eggs, then the rest of the dressing and parmesan.
l: Keep the dressing and croutons separate and dress just before eating. The chicken and asparagus are good cold.
g: GF bread for the croutons, baked on a separate tray. Check the Worcestershire, as some contain malt vinegar.
